column1: # Ledger of every `CALLER-CONTRACT:` definition in the tree, checked by scripts/ci/caller_contracts.py (CI).
# Owner rule, 2026-11-13: a function that relies on its caller instead of validating its inputs carries a
# doc comment starting `CALLER-CONTRACT:` (what the caller must guarantee, why it is not validated, what
# breaks otherwise). Each such comment needs a reviewed row here, so a new deviation cannot appear silently.
# Row: path<TAB>item<TAB>count<TAB>one-line reason. `item` is the first fn/struct/impl/#define/C function
# after the comment block; `count` is how many definitions it carries. The list is exact: a missing row, a
# wrong count, a stale row (the contract was removed) or an empty reason fails the gate. Citations of the
# marker in running prose are not definitions. Added 2026-11-14.
